title: Kim Jong-un arrives in China, South Korea says
detail: Kim Jong-un has arrived in China, according to South Korean officials cited by The New York Times on Oct 24. Details of the itinerary and agenda were not yet confirmed.

title: Kim Jong Un crosses new bridge linking North Korea and China
detail: Al Jazeera reports Kim Jong Un crossed a newly built bridge linking North Korea and China, in footage published Oct 24, amid reports of his arrival in China.
